assertions.description: The bundled recorded dataset replays all 24 hourly observations without error.
Replay order is dataset order (index-addressed), never wall-clock order.
EVERY published sample carries a source object naming the dataset, its provider, its licence and its observation timestamp.
Two independent replays are byte-identical and wrap cleanly at the end of the series.
Live weather is disabled by default and refuses with a requiredToSupport; enabling it with an empty allowlist is also refused.
A non-allowlisted host is refused WITHOUT any network call, and the refusal is recorded in the provider audit log.
An unknown provider name is refused rather than defaulted to something.
With no configuration at all the environment solver resolves to the recorded dataset and can describe its provenance.
